### WHAT THE EO ITSELF SAYS (verbatim — primary source, fetched 2026-08-03 ~9:45am PDT)
- **Covered-model definition:** *"develop and maintain a **classified** benchmarking process to assess the
  advanced **cyber** capabilities of AI models and determine the threshold at which an AI model should be
  designated a **'covered frontier model'**."* **No compute threshold, no FLOP number anywhere in the order.**
- **Who writes the framework (60 days):** *"the Secretary of the Treasury, the Secretary of War, through the
  Director of NSA, and the Secretary of Homeland Security, through the Director of CISA."*
- **The framework's purpose:** *"design a voluntary framework with AI developers through which developers
  would be able to: (i) engage the Federal Government to determine whether model(s) under development meet
  the designation of 'covered frontier model'"* and collaborate to *"select trusted partners that will have
  early access."*
- **Access provision:** *"provide the Federal Government with access to covered frontier models, subject to
  appropriate confidentiality, cybersecurity, insider-risk, and intellectual-property protection, use, and
  nondisclosure requirements, for a period of up to 30 days before they plan to release such models **to
  other trusted partners**."*
- **Anti-mandate clause:** *"Nothing in this section shall be construed to authorize the creation of a
  mandatory governmental licensing, preclearance, or permitting requirement."*
- **Enforcement:** *"Attorney General shall prioritize the enforcement of 18 U.S.C. 1028, 18 U.S.C. 1030,
  18 U.S.C. 1343"* **against criminal AI MISUSE.** **No Defense Production Act, no procurement conditioning,
  no penalty provisions in the order.**
- **Authorities cited:** 44 U.S.C. 3552(b)(6)(A); 18 U.S.C. 1028, 1030, 1343.
- **Other 30-day items (all cyber defense):** CNSS → national security systems · Secretary of War →
  Department of War systems · DHS/CISA → civilian federal systems directives · Treasury+NSA+DHS → *"an AI
  cybersecurity clearinghouse"* · OMB → federal grant funding review.
- **Reported consultation:** *"Leading up to the deadline, the three labs gave the administration feedback
  on a draft of the framework"* — **Anthropic, OpenAI, Google.** Official adds the administration engages
  *"many more"* partners than those three. *(Axios.)*

### ⬜ WHAT IS NOT KNOWN — the list that matters
1. **The framework's text.** Unpublished. The EO does **not** classify it; withholding is discretionary.
2. **Who has seen it.** No roster.
3. **When it starts.** No date given; *"discussions about next steps are underway."*
4. **The covered-model threshold.** Classified by the EO's own terms; shared *"as appropriate."*
5. **Whether any model has been designated a covered frontier model.** No report either way.
6. **Who the *"trusted partners"* are.** Undisclosed.
7. **Whether the 30-day items due 2026-07-02 were met.** No report found.
